# Revvin

> Referral program platform for service businesses. A flat $49/month subscription gives a business a branded referral page, a shareable link, a QR code, a lead inbox, and a dashboard. There is no trial and no platform fees. Businesses optionally list on the public Revvin marketplace. Businesses pay their referrers directly off-platform when deals close; Revvin is the infrastructure and does not process payouts.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Revvin is and how the referral system works.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): End-to-end walkthrough of the referral flow.

- [For referrers](/for-referrers): How people earn by sending warm leads to local businesses.
- [Browse offers](/browse): Marketplace of active referral offers.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Flat $49/month, no trial, no setup fee, cancel anytime. Referrers free.

## Referral programs by trade

- [Roofing referral program](/referral-program/roofing): How roofing companies run referrals, repeat exterior work, and reviews.
- [HVAC referral program](/referral-program/hvac): Referrals after installs plus maintenance reactivation.
- [Plumbing referral program](/referral-program/plumbing): Referrals at the moment of relief plus deferred-job reactivation.
- [Solar referral program](/referral-program/solar): Referrals from an installed base plus battery and add-on work.
- [Electrician referral program](/referral-program/electrical): Referrals from panel, rewire, and EV charger work.
- [Landscaping referral program](/referral-program/landscaping): Street-level referrals plus seasonal reactivation.
- [Painting referral program](/referral-program/painting): Referrals from finished rooms plus room-by-room repeat work.
- [Auto detailing referral program](/referral-program/auto-detailing): Referrals at handover plus short-cycle rebooking.
